en: A black‑and‑white winter scene of a rural railway station labeled "Ottestad Station". The wooden station building stands on the left beside snow‑covered tracks that stretch into the distance on the right. Frosted trees and bushes surround the building, and a few people stand on the platform near the entrance. Overhead wires and telegraph poles line the tracks, contributing to an early 20th‑century atmosphere.
